figurative_meaning_bn: কড়া জীবন, যা সহজে মরে না
figurative_meaning_en: A tenacious life that does not die easily
example_sentences_in_bangla: ওর কৈমাছের প্রাণ, এত সহজে হার মানবে না।
এই রোগে তার কৈমাছের প্রাণ বাঁচিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has the life of a climbing perch; he won't give up easily.
His tenacious life saved him from this illness.
history: The idiom derives from the climbing perch fish (কৈমাছ), known in Bengali culture for its ability to survive out of water by breathing air and moving on land, symbolizing extraordinary resilience.
note: The fish's biological adaptations in rural Bengal wetlands inspire this expression of enduring vitality.
